req.title: OpenAPI includes task schemas
req.statement: The system shall document TaskCreate, TaskUpdate, and Task schemas in the OpenAPI spec.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-040 requires that the OpenAPI spec (GET /openapi.json) documents TaskCreate, TaskUpdate, and Task schemas. Tests must verify: (1) positive — all three schema names appear in the spec's components/schemas section with correct HTTP 200 status; (2) negative — the spec does not contain fabricated/non-existent schema names; (3) boundary — each schema contains the exact fields defined in schemas.py (title, description, completed for TaskCreate; title/description/completed optional for TaskUpdate; id/created_at/updated_at added for Task). Mutation-resilient assertions use exact string keys, exact status codes, and exact field membership checks to catch constant-mutation, key-rename, and boolean-negation operators.

tests.name: test_openapi_contains_all_three_task_schemas
trace: R-TASK-040: system shall document TaskCreate, TaskUpdate, and Task schemas
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_openapi_contains_all_three_task_schemas():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/openapi.json")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    spec = r.json()
    schemas = spec["components"]["schemas"]
    assert "TaskCreate" in schemas, f"TaskCreate missing from schemas: {list(schemas.keys())}"
    assert "TaskUpdate" in schemas, f"TaskUpdate missing from schemas: {list(schemas.keys())}"
    assert "Task" in schemas, f"Task missing from schemas: {list(schemas.keys())}"

test_openapi_contains_all_three_task_schemas()

tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_openapi_task_create_schema_has_exact_required_fields():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/openapi.json")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    spec = r.json()
    tc = spec["components"]["schemas"]["TaskCreate"]
    props = tc["properties"]
    assert "title" in props
    assert "description" in props
    assert "completed" in props
    required = tc.get("required", [])
    assert "title" in required
    assert "description" not in required
    assert "completed" not in required

test_openapi_task_create_schema_has_exact_required_fields()

trace: R-TASK-040: Expected outcomes: HTTP 2xx response; Error pathways: HTTP 4xx on client error
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_openapi_json_returns_http_200_not_4xx():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/openapi.json")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.status_code != 404
    assert r.status_code != 422
    assert r.status_code != 500
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body, dict)
    assert "openapi" in body
    assert "info" in body
    assert "paths" in body

test_openapi_json_returns_http_200_not_4xx()
